question:
**Identify the correct spelling of the underlined word.**

Those friends meet __occassionaly__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Occasionally**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**occasionally**'.
 
• It means at infrequent or irregular intervals; now and then. (कभी-कभार या अनियमित अंतराल पर; जब तब)
 
• The word is an adverb and is used to describe the frequency of an action.
 
 
• **Example**: *She occasionally visits her grandparents who live in the countryside.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
